rules: gameItemId is authoritative; never resolve icons by UI/localized string at runtime.
Reuse iconKey/drawable across any number of items.
Shared-family entries must be resolved once to an authentic MHP3 atlas cell before the new item is exposed without fallback.

sharedResolutionQueue.requiredAction: Resolve one exact 16x16 cell from the pinned MHP3 atlas (or reuse an already-integrated iconKey if pixel-identical). Never create per-item bitmaps.
